style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Table Centrepiece Swag with Velvet Bow
style.toneOfVoice:
Add a touch of timeless elegance to your seasonal decor with this artificial 80cm table centrepiece swag, beautifully adorned with a luxurious white velvet bow. This stunning artificial swag combines lush greenery, delicate faux florals, and rich textures to create a sophisticated and eye-catching centrepiece that’s perfect for any occasion. At 80cm, it’s the ideal size to make a statement on your dining table, mantle, or coffee table. The soft, creamy white velvet bow adds an extra layer of elegance, complementing the natural beauty of the greenery and florals for a chic, refined look. Whether it’s for a festive celebration, a cosy holiday dinner, or simply to brighten up your home, this swag will effortlessly enhance any space. Crafted with high-quality materials, this centrepiece ensures you can enjoy its beauty season after season. Elevate your home’s ambiance and impress your guests with this elegant and versatile centrepiece that blends effortlessly into any decor style.

• Swag Length: L80cm.

Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions.
